$comment: What: the small settings the synthetic k6 summaries of this folder were generated with (common + per test type), so the fixtures stay short (6 report windows, 3 staircase levels). How: unit tests resolve these with resolveSettings (through ../shared.mjs) and check the result equals each fixture's context.phasePlan; a change in lib/ or defaults.json that alters the plan then shows up as a failing test instead of silently stale fixtures. Needs: config/settings/defaults.json names. Outputs: --set style overrides (strings as on the command line).
